unlisted_practices: Balance AI-driven ontology automation with expert validation and human oversight to prevent hallucinated concepts, misclassifications, and propagated bias.
Manage ontology updates with structured governance, version control, validation tools, and stakeholder collaboration to preserve backward compatibility.
Develop healthcare ontologies through collaboration among clinicians, researchers, informaticians, and policymakers.
Align healthcare ontologies with international standards such as HL7 FHIR, SNOMED CT, LOINC, and ICD to support interoperability.
